promise: Pixel Plus turns one small idea into ads, animation and software with the polish of a top motion studio
cta: ابدأ مشروعك معنا — start your project with Pixel Plus (no contact details were supplied, so none are shown)
direction: «One pixel»: the blue square from the logo's i-dot is the only hero; it morphs (UI-morph grammar of the two owner references) through three worlds — blue ads, paper animation, dark software — and finally bursts into 1,699 pixels that build the logo pixel by pixel. Alexandria (Arabic + Latin display/text) + Space Mono (code/labels). creative.viewer: a business owner or marketer on Facebook Reels deciding which studio can make their ad, animation or app
creative.problem: agency ads all claim creativity; this one must PROVE motion craft in the first seconds and stay elegant, Arabic and premium
creative.promise: one idea → ads, animation and software, built pixel by pixel
creative.evidence: the real Pixel Plus logo (traced from the owner's file) and the film itself as the showreel; no invented clients, numbers or results
creative.emotion: admiration and calm confidence, with playful wit
creative.motif: one blue pixel (the logo's i-dot) that becomes everything and finally becomes the logo
creative.light: soft warm paper with a centre glow, a saturated brand-blue world and a dark night-mode world; soft contact shadows under objects
creative.camera: locked frame with the object moving (reference grammar), plus one portal dive into the pixel
creative.motion: spring morphs of one container (size/radius/colour) with motion blur, blur cross-fades of content, squash and stretch, onion skin, typewriter code, particle assembly
creative.sound: 120 BPM energetic dance-pop in A minor: hook teaser + build, drop at 4.0, bounce groove + heartbeat break, dark driving section, three stabs, final chorus on the logo; UI foley clicks/pops on every interaction
creative.pacing: one idea per beat inside a chapter, a readable 2 s headline hold per chapter, quiet logo hold at the end
creative.payoff: the pixel bursts into 1,699 pixels that assemble the Pixel Plus logo; tagline «نصنع الفرق.. بكسل ببكسل»; credit Made by: Mohamed Fawzy Labib
